name: Exp_ColorBears.mq5
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBears custom indicator, which uses dual-smoothed bearish momentum to generate buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from bearish to bullish color (0→2) and sell positions when it transitions from bullish to bearish color (2→0), with configurable position closing on signal reversals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBears自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑的熊市动量来生成买卖信号。当指标颜色从熊市转为牛市(0→2)时开多仓，从牛市转为熊市(2→0)时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于ColorBears指标的双重平滑动量判断，通过两层不同平滑算法（第一层用于指标本身的平滑，第二层用于信号线的平滑）来过滤市场噪音。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1在SignalBar位置值为0（无熊市动量）且缓冲区0值为2（牛市信号色）时开多仓；当缓冲区1值为2（熊市动量）且缓冲区0值为0（无牛市动量）时开空仓。出场条件依赖信号反转：当出现相反信号时，根据BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数决定是否平仓，同时设有固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额、基于净值、基于可用保证金和基于亏损后余额计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择具体的资金管理方式，但没有动态调整或加仓减仓机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on the ColorBears indicator's dual-smoothed momentum assessment, using two layers of different smoothing algorithms (the first for the indicator itself, the second for the signal line) to filter market noise. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 1 at SignalBar equals 0 (no bearish momentum) and buffer 0 equals 2 (bullish signal color); a sell position opens when buffer 1 equals 2 (bearish momentum) and buffer 0 equals 0 (no bullish momentum). Exit conditions rely on signal reversal: when an opposite signal appears, positions close based on BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters, with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based, equity-based, free margin-based, and loss-adjusted balance calculation. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for the specific calculation method, but there is no dynamic adjustment or scale-in/scale-out mechanism.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: free margin/balance/margin minus loss/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许信号反转时平多仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing long positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许信号反转时平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: Phase1
parameters.description: 指标第一层平滑相位参数

pros: 双重平滑算法有效过滤市场噪音，减少虚假信号
支持10种平滑方法和10种价格类型，灵活度高
买卖方向均可独立控制开仓和平仓，策略可灵活组合
使用IsNewBar()进行新K线检测，避免同一K线内重复交易
提供5种资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好
pros_en: Dual smoothing algorithm effectively filters market noise and reduces false signals
Supports 10 smoothing methods and 10 price types for high flexibility
Buy and sell directions can be independently controlled for both opening and closing
Uses IsNewBar() for new bar detection, preventing repeated trades within the same bar
Provides 5 money management modes to accommodate different risk preferences
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁触发虚假信号
止损1000点/止盈2000点的默认值过于宽泛，未根据市场波动率动态调整
没有持仓数量检查，可能在同一方向重复开仓
ColorBears指标为自定义指标，依赖外部文件，部署复杂
缺少回撤控制和最大持仓限制等风险防护机制
cons_en: Lacks spread filter, which may trigger false signals frequently in high-spread environments
Default SL 1000/TP 2000 points are excessively wide without dynamic ATR-based adjustment
No position count check, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
ColorBears is a custom indicator requiring external files, making deployment complex
Missing drawdown control and maximum position limits as risk protection mechanisms
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离
添加点差过滤和最大持仓检查，提升在不利市场条件下的稳定性
增加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定利润
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit that auto-adjusts based on market volatility
Add spread filter and maximum position check to improve stability under adverse market conditions
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in profits during trend continuation

risk_points: 没有持仓数量限制，可能在同一方向重复开仓导致过度暴露
固定止损止盈不适应市场波动率变化，可能在低波动时止损过宽、高波动时止损过窄
依赖自定义指标文件，若指标加载失败则EA无法运行但不会自动防护
risk_points_en: No position count limit, potentially over-exposing in the same direction with duplicate positions
Fixed SL/TP does not adapt to market volatility changes, potentially too wide in low volatility or too narrow in high volatility
Depends on custom indicator file; if indicator fails to load, EA cannot run but lacks auto-protection
